# Coddy public contracts

These contracts accompany all visibility settings. Variable type declarations do not specify zero-value runtime initialization. The execution harness uses the complete implementation.

## Public schemas

`CODDY_CONFIG_SCHEMA.json` preserves `docs/config.schema.json` unchanged. Background-tool defaults are at `properties.tools.properties.background.properties`.

`CODDY_OPENAPI.json` was exported from the public document constructor under the admitted `http` build tag without starting a server. Its version is `dev` because no release linker value was injected. Sources: `external/httpserver/openapi.go:16`, `external/httpserver/scheduler_http_stub.go:9`, `external/httpserver/memory_http_stub.go:9`.

## Calling conventions

- **bgtask.New / NewWithRunner**: New runs commands with the host command runner. NewWithRunner accepts an injected Runner; nil selects the host command runner. Numeric configuration defaults are specified in CODDY_CONFIG_SCHEMA.json. Source: `internal/bgtask/pool.go:98`.

- **prompts.Render / RenderWithFallback**: An empty prompt directory selects built-in templates. A supplied directory selects the requested mode-specific template filename. Modes are agent, plan, and ask; unknown modes use the agent template. Render returns loading, parsing, or rendering errors. RenderWithFallback returns a fallback prompt on error. Source: `internal/prompts/loader.go:86`.

- **agent.ToolSet**: ToolSet is an allowlist of tool names. Empty or nil means unrestricted: all registry definitions, plus MCP tools when wired by the agent. Source: `internal/agent/toolsets.go:9`.

- **subagents.Parse**: Without an explicit name, the definition name defaults to the filename stem, or the parent directory name for <name>/AGENT.md. Source: `internal/subagents/definition.go:126`.


## Marketplace manifest inputs

Marketplace manifests are discovered at `.agents/plugins/marketplace.json` or `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json`. Unknown top-level fields are ignored. `metadata.version` supplies a missing plugin version. A plugin source accepts an object such as `{"source":"github","repo":"owner/repo"}` or `{"source":"url","url":"...","ref":"main"}`, or a string giving a relative repository path or git URL. `PluginSource.Kind` is `github`, `url`, or `path`; `Repo` is owner/repository, `URL` is the git/HTTP URL, `Ref` is a branch or tag, and `Path` is a relative marketplace-repository path. Sources: `internal/skills/manifest.go:10`, `:20`, `:36`.

## Prompt templates

Templates use Go `text/template`. Names: `agent.md`, `plan.md`, `ask.md`. Source: `internal/prompts/loader.go:37`.

- `CWD`: CWD is the session working directory.

- `Skills`: Skills is preformatted markdown for slash skills (may be empty).

- `Rules`: Rules is preformatted markdown for active project rules (may be empty).

- `Tools`: Tools is a human-readable markdown list of tools for the current mode (may be empty).

- `Memory`: Memory is session-scoped notes injected into the prompt (may be empty).

- `TodoList`: TodoList is the current session checklist as markdown lines (may be empty).

- `PlanContext`: PlanContext is design plan text injected when the user runs a saved plan (may be empty).

- `DiscardedPlans`: DiscardedPlans is plan-mode guidance when the user discarded design plan slugs (may be empty).

- `Instructions`: Instructions is the concatenated content of project instruction files (AGENTS.md etc.), may be empty.

- `Subagents`: Subagents is the catalog block a parent that may spawn subagents reads (may be empty).

- `SubagentRole`: SubagentRole is the role block of a child agent run (may be empty).

- `UTCNow`: UTCNow is the wall-clock instant in RFC3339 (UTC) at render time for model grounding.

Feature: Settings fetches the reasoning levels a model id offers
  Reasoning levels are auto-detected from the API model id, so an operator adding a
  logical model would otherwise have to know each family's tiers by heart. The
  settings form asks the gateway instead: GET /coddy/config/reasoning-levels reports
  the levels that model id offers when no reasoning_levels override is configured,
  under the same provider-aware remap the composer and GET /v1/models apply. The
  model id travels as a query parameter because the entry being edited has not been
  saved yet.

  Scenario: A Qwen3 model id offers the standard reasoning tiers
    Given a coddy gateway with an "openai" provider named "valera"
    When the settings form fetches the reasoning levels for "valera/qwen3.8-27b"
    Then the gateway answers with the levels "low,medium,high"
    And the answer reports the levels as detected

  Scenario: A codex-backed gpt-5 id offers none in place of minimal
    Given a coddy gateway with a "codex" provider named "codex"
    When the settings form fetches the reasoning levels for "codex/gpt-5.5"
    Then the gateway answers with the levels "none,low,medium,high"
    And the answer reports the levels as detected

  Scenario: A model without reasoning support answers with an empty list
    Given a coddy gateway with an "openai" provider named "valera"
    When the settings form fetches the reasoning levels for "valera/gpt-4o"
    Then the gateway answers with no levels
    And the answer reports the levels as not detected

  Scenario: A codex provider that is not saved yet already gets the codex tiers
    Given a coddy gateway with an "openai" provider named "valera"
    When the settings form fetches the reasoning levels for "brand-new/gpt-5.5" of a "codex" provider
    Then the gateway answers with the levels "none,low,medium,high"
    And the answer reports the levels as detected
